description: This file defines a React component called RouteMap used for visualizing bus routes, stops, buses, and related map features as an SVG-based campus map with grid, paths, and markers.

methods.name: createProjector
methods.description: Creates a projection function to map latitude and longitude coordinates to x/y coordinates within the SVG canvas, with padding and scaling.

methods.name: Grid
methods.description: Renders grid lines on the SVG background at specified intervals.

methods.name: RoutePath
methods.description: Draws a route polyline based on route stops, projected onto the SVG plane.

methods.name: StopDot
methods.description: Renders a visual marker for a stop, including a circle and label.

methods.name: BusMarker
methods.description: Displays a bus icon with occupancy and status label at projected position.

methods.name: Legend
methods.description: Provides a legend legend indicating color codes for bus statuses.
